verdict.rationale: Channel3 is agentic-commerce infrastructure (product catalog search, buy URLs, sale attribution), so issuing scoped agent payment credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no way to give an agent a credential with amount limits, expiry, or merchant restrictions. The MPP mention only covers agents paying Channel3 for its own API usage, an adjacent feature, not a scoped purchasing credential.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand my agent a scoped, limited-use payment credential — amount limits, expiry, merchant restrictions — instead of a raw card number
